title: Neighbor found man 69 on the floor: garbled speech, mouth hanging on the right

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's 37 Kirkham Street, the downstairs unit. I'm his neighbor.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I just found him on the kitchen floor. He's awake but his speech is all garbled, I can't understand a word.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: What does his face look like?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The right side of his mouth is hanging down, like it's melting.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I don't know. I just found him like this. I haven't seen him since the weekend.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Do you know if he takes any medications?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No idea, sorry. I don't know what he takes.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with him and don't move him.
